# 21st Century Apartments — Executive Serviced Residences Lagos

> 21st Century Apartments provides ultra-luxury serviced residences and executive short-stay hospitality across prime Lagos commercial and waterfront districts: Eko Atlantic City, Victoria Island, Lekki Phase 1, and Ikeja GRA.

## Core Information
- **Brand**: 21ST CENTURY APARTMENTS
- **Legal Entity**: 21st Century Serviced Apartments & Hospitality Ltd
- **Headquarters**: 12B Eko Boulevard, Ocean Front District, Eko Atlantic City, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Mainland Concierge Office**: 42 Isaac John Street, Ikeja GRA, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Primary Telephone**: +234 817 611 5993
- **Secondary Telephone**: +234 818 200 1144
- **WhatsApp Concierge**: https://wa.me/2348176115993
- **Primary Email**: reservations@21stcenturyapartments.ng
- **Concierge Desk**: concierge@21stcenturyapartments.ng
- **Official Website**: https://21st-century-apartments.vercel.app

## Infrastructure & Amenities
- **Guaranteed Power**: Subterranean municipal grid backed by synchronized dual CAT diesel generators with automatic transfer switches (zero brownout architecture).
- **High-Speed Connectivity**: Starlink Enterprise low-latency satellite broadband paired with redundant terrestrial fiber optic lines across every apartment.
- **Security & Access**: Gated perimeter compound security, biometric elevator access, discrete CCTV coverage of access corridors, and armed Lagos security escorts available on request.
- **Kitchens & Living**: Fully equipped designer kitchens, integrated induction hobs, microwave ovens, double-door refrigerators, en-suite Italian marble bathrooms, and in-unit washer/dryers.
- **Hospitality Services**: Daily discrete housekeeping, fresh linen & Egyptian cotton towel rotation, private chef on request, and airport chauffeur transfer via executive Mercedes-Benz Sprinter / SUVs.

## Booking & Reservation Policy
- **Request-to-Book Workflow**: All reservations operate as verified booking requests. Submitting dates does not charge any card immediately.
- **Verification Guarantee**: Concierge staff verify calendar clearance, utility health, and guest requirements within 15 minutes of request submission.
- **Payment & Invoicing**: Official electronic invoices with company bank details (NGN/USD) or secure payment links are issued once dates are locked.
- **Refundable Caution Deposit**: A standard caution deposit is collected prior to key handover and refunded within 24 hours of checkout following inventory clearance.
- **Strict Discretion**: Guest confidentiality, non-disclosure compliance, and private registration protocol for dignitaries and high-net-worth individuals.
